analysis.subject: finance
analysis.pageCoverage: Page explains the makeup of a mortgage payment, defining principal and interest, describing escrow for taxes and insurance, showing the total payment formula and how to compare offers and locate estimate on Loan Estimate.

overview.headline: How total mortgage payment builds from principal and interest plus escrow

keyPoints.point: Students learn that principal is the amount borrowed and interest is the charge the lender applies for lending money.
keyPoints.quote: The principal is the amount you borrowed and have to pay back, and interest is what the lender charges for lending you the money.

keyPoints.point: Total monthly payment includes additional costs such as homeowners insurance and taxes beyond principal and interest.
keyPoints.quote: your total monthly payment usually includes additional costs like homeowners insurance, taxes, and possibly mortgage insurance

keyPoints.point: Escrow account holds money until insurance and tax bills are due and then pays them on behalf of borrower.
keyPoints.quote: Your mortgage company typically holds the money in the escrow account until those insurance and tax bills are due, and then pays them on your behalf

keyPoints.point: Principal and interest generally remain same while escrow payment can change when property taxes increase.
keyPoints.quote: your principal and interest payment will generally remain the same as long as you make regular payments on time

keyTerms.gloss: Amount borrowed that must be paid back over time
keyTerms.quote: The principal is the amount you borrowed and have to pay back, and interest is what the lender charges for lending you the money.

keyTerms.gloss: Charge from lender for borrowing money
keyTerms.quote: interest is what the lender charges for lending you the money

keyTerms.gloss: Account that holds funds for taxes and insurance bills
keyTerms.quote: If you have an escrow account, you pay a set amount with every mortgage payment for these expenses

keyTerms.gloss: Insurance premium that may be added to monthly payment when required
keyTerms.quote: Principal + interest + mortgage insurance (if applicable) + escrow (homeowners insurance and tax) = total monthly payment

keyTerms.gloss: Combined amount that includes escrow and insurance costs each month
keyTerms.quote: your total monthly payment usually includes additional costs like homeowners insurance, taxes, and possibly mortgage insurance

componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Contrast highlights what each payment includes and why escrow makes total higher than principal and interest alone.
componentPlan.focusQuote: Principal + interest + mortgage insurance (if applicable) + escrow (homeowners insurance and tax) = total monthly payment

componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Quick checks reinforce escrow function, payment stability and where to locate estimate so learners avoid common homebuyer mistake.
componentPlan.focusQuote: You can find your estimated total monthly payment on page 1 of the Loan Estimate, in the “Projected Payments” section
